slides.title: What Indovinando is
slides.description: Indovinando is a blind tasting game: players taste covered bottles and answer a quiz.
points: The questionnaire stays the same for every bottle.
For each bottle, players select one correct answer per question.
At the end of each round you see results, points and ranking.

slides.title: How gameplay works
slides.description: The match goes bottle by bottle, always using the same questionnaire.
points: Round 1: covered bottle, answer all questions.
Reveal: the bottle is shown and points are assigned.
Then move to the next bottle until the final leaderboard.

slides.title: How to create a game
slides.description: First build the questionnaire, then add bottles with the correct answers.
points: 1) Create the questionnaire with questions and options.
2) Add your selected bottles (name, producer, vintage).
3) For each bottle, set the correct answer for each question.

slides.title: Enoteca Mode
slides.description: A table-friendly flow for in-person tasting rounds with nickname sessions.
points: Join and play from the same table.
Score bottle by bottle in a guided flow.
Great for wine bars, classes and private tastings.

slides.title: Live Multiplayer
slides.description: Host a realtime game session and show results round by round.
points: Players join with nickname and avatar.
Round status and scoring updates live.
Final leaderboard at the end of the game.

slides.title: Wine Course
slides.description: Learn wine step by step with didactic slides, quiz rounds and progress tracking.
points: Levels and lessons organized by topic.
Best score and attempts tracked per lesson.
Great for continuous training over time.
